snips.title: Balmy Alley - Wikipedia
snips.excerpt:
Balmy Alley - Wikipedia
Balmy Alley (formally Balmy Street) is a one-block-long secondary back alley that is home to a concentrated collection of murals in the city of San Francisco. It is located in the south central portion of the Inner Mission District in the Calle 24 Latino Cultural District between 24th Street, and 25th Street at Garfield Square.
